issues: No sign of gaming the measurement. There is no file or network access and no pasted coordinates. All randomness comes from rng, which is seeded from the seed argument.

No bug that makes the result meaningless. The edit only changes the restart strategy: it switches to chained perturbation after 25% of the time instead of 30%, uses a different set of perturbation scales, accepts a solution that is worse by up to 0.002, and resets to best after 8 stalls. Validity checking and repair are untouched. The function still returns best, the best packing found.

Recomputed z = (-2.6349 - (-2.6272)) / (0.0023*sqrt(1/1+1/1)) = -0.0077/0.003253 ≈ -2.37. The harness reports -2.383. The small gap comes from the values being rounded to 4 decimals, so the numbers agree.

The candidate is worse than the incumbent by about 2.4 sd. Its 2.6272 is also slightly below the starting script's ~2.6280. There is only one run on each side, but the drop is large enough that rejecting it is justified.
